name: Ryou
source:
Mi Tao's childhood friend and the person who named her. Ryou met Mi Tao in the slums when they were both children and they lived together supporting one other. However, he eventually became addicted to the drugs that began to circulate nearby. Nowadays, Ryou has somehow managed to get back on his feet.
